attempts.summary: Deployed PostgreSQL 9.5 streaming replication across node1 (primary), node2 and node3 (standbys). Demonstrated the required failover: stopped node1, promoted node2 to writable primary with zero data loss (confirmed via matching WAL LSNs before failover), repointed node3 to follow node2 via timeline-following recovery, then rebuilt node1 as a standby of node2 using pg_basebackup. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol on all three nodes (standbys first, primary last), confirming changed boot IDs and full replication/data recovery after each restart.
